name: War-Awoken Black Mage's Dual Memory
name_jp: 戦醒黒魔道士の記憶・双
effects:
Tactical Awoken Mode & +500 MAG to user
Tactical Awoken Mode: Ice/Lightning Ability Boost, Triplecast Ice/Lightning, Unlimited Ice/Lightning Hones, Cap Break Level 1 to Ice/Lightning Abilities, Ice/Lightning Ability Damage +30% & ATB Speed x1.1 to Ice/Lightning Abilities; Ends after using 8 Ice/Lightning abilities
TP Max: AOE Ice/NE or Lightning/NE magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1 under En-Ice or En-Lightning

WS Gold: Dualcast Ice/Lightning 2, Instant Ice/Lightning 2 & Weakness Damage +30% for 2 turns to party
